edgar_concentrations.excerpt: 11 Table of Contents Concentration of Credit Risk Financial instruments which potentially subject us to concentrations of credit risk consist primarily of cash, cash equivalents, short-term marketable securities, and accounts receivable. We limit our exposure to credit risk by placing our cash and investments with a few major financial institutions. We have also established guidelines regarding diversification of our investments and their maturities that are designed to maintain principal and maximize liquidity. We review these guidelines periodically and modify them to take advantage of trends in yields and interest rates and changes in our operations and financial position. We monitor the creditworthiness of our customers based on historical trends, the financial condition of our customers, and external market factors. Contract Balances Contract balances represent amounts presented in our condensed consolidated balance sheets when either we have transferred goods or services to the customer or the customer has paid consideration to us under the contract. These contract balances include accounts receivable and deferred revenue. Payment terms vary by contract type and type of customer and generally range from 30 to 90 days. As of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, accounts receivable included unbilled amounts of $ 19.9 million and $ 16.9 million, respectively. We expect to invoice and collect all unbilled accounts receivable within twelve months. We record deferred revenue when cash payments have been received prior to satisfaction of the related performance obligation. Our performance obligations are generally satisfied within twelve months of the initial contract date. As of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, the current deferred revenue balances were not material. Net Income Per Share Basic net income per share attributable to common stockholders is calculated by dividing the net income attributable to common stockholders by the weighted-average number of common shares outstanding during the period. Diluted net income per share is computed using the weighted average number of common shares outstanding during the period and, when dilutive, potential common share equivalents. Potentially dilutive common shares consist of shares issuable from restricted stock units, or RSUs, performance stock units, or PSUs, and our senior convertible notes. Other instruments, including warrants and sales‑based milestones, are evaluated when applicable. Potentially dilutive common shares issuable upon vesting of RSUs and PSUs are determined using the average share price for each period under the treasury stock method.

items.claim: CFO 表示長期計畫（LRP）至 2030 年每年營收成長 10% 以上
items.quote: 10% plus every year, each year in our LRP through 2030
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 澄清 10% 以上不是 CAGR 或平均，而是逐年
items.quote: It's 10% plus each year every year.
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 說 LRP 已納入 2028 年起的競標假設
items.quote: competitive bidding assumptions starting in 2028
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 說 LRP 已納入競爭對手新品上市假設
items.quote: competitor product launches over the course of time
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 回答價量組合：價格假設每年約 2% 至 3%（各年不同）
items.quote: we've typically thought about 2% to 3% price
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 對競標的假設：納入名目價格影響
items.quote: some nominal price impacts associated with it
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 說 LRP 中 Medicare 涵蓋時點假設為 2027 年中
items.quote: for LRP purposes, we put it in the middle of 2027
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CEO 表示公司規劃假設 CMS 涵蓋於明年年中生效
items.quote: coverage will come the middle of next year
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: Coleman 在 Q&A 說 CMS 非胰島素型涵蓋從未預期在 2026 年發生
items.quote: we never anticipated that to happen in '26
items.speaker: Jon Coleman

items.claim: Coleman 說若 CMS 涵蓋提早，屬上行空間
items.quote: mid-'27 is when the coverage will actually kick in
items.speaker: Jon Coleman

items.claim: CFO 預期全球涵蓋人數 2030 年底約 5200 萬（目前約 2300 萬）
items.quote: We expect to exit around 52 million
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 假設 2030 年第二型滲透率 10% 至 15%
items.quote: type 2 in the 10% to 15% range
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 假設 CMS 涵蓋後滲透速度為 basal 的一半
items.quote: CMS penetration goes at half the rate of basal
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 說明配戴使用率假設沿用網站所列 75% 至 80%
items.quote: the 75% to 80% utilization
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 說留存與使用率提升的上行未放進 LRP
items.quote: we haven't put any of this into our LRP
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 預期 LRP 結束時毛利率升至 60% 後段
items.quote: We expect gross margin to grow into the high 60s
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 預期 LRP 結束時非 GAAP 營業利益率 29% 至 30%
items.quote: get to 29% to 30% by the end of the end of the LRP
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 說營業利益率每年約擴張 150 bp，主要來自毛利率
items.quote: about 150 basis points a year
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 預期調整後 EBITDA 利益率升至 36% 至 37%
items.quote: adjusted EBITDA margin to grow to 36% to 37%
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 預期 G8 製造成本較 G7 至少低 10%
items.quote: it costs at least 10% less than it cost to make G7
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 提及 15 日款保固率可能小幅上升（管理層認為可接受）
items.quote: the warranty rate may go up a little bit
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 說近期毛利率機會：今年底美國約近半數用戶轉 15 日款，次年起點更高
items.quote: approaching 50% of our population moved over
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 說去年營運費用改善 300 bp，來自 cost to execute 框架
items.quote: 300 basis points of operating expense improvement
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CEO 說公司目前營業利益率已超過 20% 且仍有空間
items.quote: operating at margins of over 20% with additional room to go
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CFO 表示 10 億美元回購授權將於 2026 年執行完畢
items.quote: It will be fully executed in 2026.
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 提出未來每年至少 50% 自由現金流用於回購
items.quote: at least 50% of our annual free cash flow to repurchases
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 稱股價有落差時要回購
items.quote: And boy, we see a big one today.
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CFO 列出支持小型併購為資本配置用途之一
items.quote: We want to be able to support tuck-in M&A.
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

items.claim: CEO 說 G8 預計明年送件，2027 年底或 2028 年初上市
items.quote: a launch either at the end of '27 or early '28
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說今年底前轉換近半美國用戶至 G7 15 日款
items.quote: convert nearly half of our U.S. base over to this product
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說明年推出醫院連續血糖監測產品
items.quote: We want to be able to support tuck-in M&A.
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說酮體感測會納入 G8 平台但時程在後
items.quote: Ketones, it will be part of the G8 platform.
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說 G8 之後將有多分析物版本
items.quote: right behind that product is a multi-analyte version of G8
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: Coleman 表示國際收入願景：LRP 結束時達數十億美元
items.quote: you'll see multibillions of dollars in international
items.speaker: Jon Coleman

items.claim: CEO 說 Smart Basal 把達到合適劑量的時間從 12 週以上縮短到 30 天內
items.quote: from over 12 weeks to fewer than 30 days
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說 EHR 直接整合已有逾 320 家醫療系統整合或導入中
items.quote: We have over 320 health systems
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說 G7 產線可改裝生產 G8，支援產能
items.quote: retrofit the G7 lines to manufacture these G8 systems
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 承認貼片黏著問題尚未完全解決
items.quote: the code is definitely not cracked
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說 Flex 美國是否推出（另一產品或 App）尚未決定（Coleman 回答）
items.quote: We've not yet made that decision
items.speaker: Jon Coleman

items.claim: Coleman 稱公司相對競爭對手已有留存優勢，並預期差距擴大
items.quote: We've already got a retention advantage
items.speaker: Jon Coleman

items.claim: 分析師提到最大競爭對手在酮體上有進展，詢問 Dexcom 路徑
items.quote: your biggest competitor is still making progress
items.speaker: Jeffrey Johnson

items.claim: Coleman 說基層醫療處方份額從 2023 年約 30% 升到 2025 年近 40%
items.quote: 2025 has grown close to 40%
items.speaker: Jon Coleman

items.claim: Coleman 說先前擴編美國銷售團隊 40%
items.quote: expand the sales force in the United States by 40%
items.speaker: Jon Coleman

items.claim: CEO 說使用者停用 CGM 的首要原因之一是認為數據不夠可靠
items.quote: they don't feel that the glucose data is reliable enough
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說非胰島素型第二型患者目前僅 25% 有涵蓋
items.quote: we're only 25% covered
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說第一季國際成長多數來自新開通涵蓋的市場
items.quote: most of that growth came from new markets
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 提到另一家 PBM 今年起涵蓋所有糖尿病人
items.quote: another PBM, the next largest, starting to cover CGM
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 宣布與 Elliott 合作新增 2 名董事
items.quote: recruit 2 new Board directors to our Board
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說正在招聘新設的 Chief Product Officer
items.quote: a brand-new role at Dexcom, a Chief Product Officer
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CEO 說董事會目前沒有獨立的醫材董事
items.quote: We don't have independent med tech directors on our Board
items.speaker: Jacob Leach

items.claim: CFO 說 CMS 關注點在詐欺性帳單，競標影響有限
items.quote: CMS is heavily focused on fraud
items.speaker: Jereme Sylvain

qa_flags.question: Jeffrey Johnson（Baird）追問酮體感測的時程與路徑
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 說酮體會納入 G8 平台，但明說不給任何確切時間表（"I'm not going to give any exact time lines"），改談 G8 準確度優先、臨床工作仍待完成

qa_flags.question: Larry Biegelsen（Wells Fargo）問銷售與利潤率假設的逐年節奏
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未給逐年數字，表示 "We don't have a cadence to provide"，留待年度財測

qa_flags.question: Joanne Wuensch（Citi）問 10% 以上各年哪年較強
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 不分年度給數字，只說 10% 以上是基礎情境，逐年細節留給年度財測，僅提供各年催化劑

qa_flags.question: Matt O'Brien（Piper Sandler）問 LRP 中美國與國際成長的相對關係
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 以存取擴張時點難控制回答，CFO 說「兩者都不輕忽」，未給美國與國際的成長拆分數字

qa_flags.question: Rich Newitter（Truist）問國際成長是否高於美國、美國是否需要第二型非胰島素型才能維持雙位數
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 表示未拆分美國與國際，改談涵蓋是成長演算法核心，未直接回答美國單獨是否雙位數

qa_flags.question: Joanne Wuensch（Citi）問 Flex 是否會帶到美國
qa_flags.response_pattern: Coleman 表示尚未決定是否為不同產品或 App，不願多談

qa_flags.question: Chris Pasquale（Nephron）問 G8 上市後的轉換策略
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 說「沒有具體轉換計畫」，只表示希望快速轉換
